root_cause: the dispatcher marks an attempt as serving only when the child echoes the nonce in its output stream; five briefs asked the officer to record the nonce inside verdict.json but not in its reply, so nonce_present stayed false, no attempt was ever accepted as serving, and the run ended without a final receipt
why_it_looked_like_a_crash: the receipt existed only as the provisional write; the final write never ran because `used` was never set
fix: the briefing contract now requires `NONCE-ECHO: <nonce>` as the first line of the officer's reply; the dispatcher is unchanged

observation.note: the model identity matches and rank is 1; the provider label differs and the gate does not compare it yet -- recorded, not hidden
